originalTitle: Clean up begins after French riots but police remain
summary: Outside of Paris, Marseille saw some of the worst damage, with shop owners reporting more than 600 premises having been looted.
content:
Following a weekend of intense rioting across France, a clean up operation has begun - but tensions remain, with police still in position and a curfew in place in some big cities.

Outside of Paris, Marseille saw some of the worst damage, with shop owners reporting more than 600 premises having been looted.

From the port city in southern France, the BBC's Nick Beake explains some of the factors behind the protests.
chineseTitle: 法国骚乱后开始清理工作但警察仍在
chineseSummary: 在巴黎以外的地区，马赛遭受了最严重的破坏，商店老板报告说有 600 多家店铺被洗劫一空。
chineseContent:
法国各地发生周末激烈骚乱后，清理行动已经开始，但紧张局势依然存在，警察仍在现场，一些大城市实行宵禁。

在巴黎以外的地区，马赛遭受了最严重的破坏，商店老板报告说有 600 多家店铺被洗劫一空。

英国广播公司 (BBC) 的尼克·比克 (Nick Beake) 在法国南部的港口城市解释了抗议活动背后的一些因素。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
